title: Claude Haiku 5.5 against Haiku 4.5
summary: Anthropic says Haiku 5.5 costs around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average, after cutting per-token prices by 90%. Independent per-task cost data exists only at each model's top reasoning setting, where Haiku 5.5 does far more work.

models.label: Haiku 4.5 (reasoning)
models.setting: Reasoning, as benchmarked by Artificial Analysis.

claims.text: Costs around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5 on average
claims.scopeNote: Anthropic's figure is an average over typical workloads. Artificial Analysis publishes cost per task only at each model's top reasoning setting, so this compares both at their maximum.

ref.note: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1. Haiku 5.5 at max effort used 298M output tokens against Haiku 4.5's 40M.

claims.text: Scores 72.4% on OSWorld 2.1 (offline subset), up from 15.7% for Haiku 4.5
claims.noRefNote: No independent OSWorld 2.1 run has been published yet.

observations.text: Per-token prices fell 90% ($1/$5 to $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens), so most of any saving is pricing rather than efficiency.

livePack.note: Starter tasks plus multi-step efficiency tasks.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
